source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The 2-colored straight stripe is the destination edge.
    if all(grid[r][0] == 2 for r in range(h)) or all(grid[r][-1] == 2 for r in range(h)):

        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (3, 2)]
        color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        left, right = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        shift = edge_col - 1 - right if edge_col > right else edge_col + 1 - left
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = 3
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c+shift] = color
        trail = (left+shift-1) if shift > 0 else (right+shift+1)
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][trail] = 8
        return out
    edge_row = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r]))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (3, 2)]
    color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    top, bottom = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    shift = edge_row - 1 - bottom if edge_row > bottom else edge_row + 1 - top
    for r,c in cells:
        out[r][c] = 3
    for r,c in cells:
        out[r+shift][c] = color
    trail = (top+shift-1) if shift > 0 else (bottom+shift+1)
    for c in range(w):

    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != 2:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (background, 2)]
    color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    if cols:
        edge_col = cols[0]
        left, right = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        shift = edge_col - 1 - right if edge_col > right else edge_col + 1 - left
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = background
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = color
        trail = left + shift - 1 if shift > 0 else right + shift + 1
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][trail] = 8
        return out
    edge_row = rows[0]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    shift = edge_row - 1 - bottom if edge_row > bottom else edge_row + 1 - top
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r + shift][c] = color
    trail = top + shift - 1 if shift > 0 else bottom + shift + 1
    for c in range(w):
        out[trail][c] = 8
    return out
'''
